capture.content_gates: OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 for the content-present event; both unset for the length-only event
capture.note: user_prompt always carries prompt_length; command_name/command_source describe a slash/MCP command. The prompt text is present only under OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 (event_sequence 2) and simply absent by default (event_sequence 8) — it is never fabricated or zero-filled. Prompts here are synthetic. prompt is captured raw (epic #87 / #94), not re-redacted at ingest; see the -otlp fixture for the wire form and the prompt.id/message.uuid correlation ids retained under provider_extensions.correlation (#106).

observations.name: prompt_content
observations.evidence: user_prompt carries prompt (behind OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS) plus prompt_length and command metadata; it maps to a canonical.Event whose provider_extensions.event echoes prompt/prompt_length/command_name/command_source verbatim. The length-only event proves length is reported without any content when the gate is off.
